QuestInfo.name: [Lion King's Castle] Knight of the Lion King
QuestInfo.0: The Lion King's castle is full of dangerous monsters! What is the owner of such a castle like? And what goes on here? Someone who can answer all these questions is approaching you.
QuestInfo.1: #p2161002# was a knight of a small kingdom a long time ago. Now, he is but a ghost. He is enraged at the corruption of his king, brought on by the Black Mage. If he's involved, then what is the relationship between the Lion King and the Black Mage? Talk to #b#p2161002##k.
QuestInfo.2: Hundreds of years ago, before the Black Mage appeared, there was a small kingdom that was poor but filled with loyalty and compassion. However, the kingdom crumbled, leaving only the Lion King and monsters.

0.0: Isn't there someone who can stop our mad king? If I were stronger, I could have done something... but I'm not. I really, really am not. If only that adventurer would get here...
0.1: Hm? I sense life. Are you the adventurer that broke down the magic wards on the castle?

yes.0: You really came. Oh, thank you! Will you give me some time to get myself together?

no.0: Was it my imagination? I could have sworn I heard someone come in.

1.0: My apologies. It excites me to see a living person in this castle. Let me tell you my story. I was a knight, long ago, before the Black Mage came. I was brave and virtuous, and I protected my king with honor, until...

yes.0: Our kingdom, though small and poor, was a peaceful place. Our king was wise and the people were loyal. Life wasn't easy, but it was filled with happiness. But now...
yes.1: Look around you. Could you even believe this castle used to be filled with laughter? Our wise king and our graceful queen are gone, and a monster and his minions are in their place now...
yes.2: The Black Mage is to blame for everything, for corrupting our king. I tried to convince the king so many times, but he never listened. He couldn't see anything beyond his thirst for revenge.
yes.3: Nothing changed after the heroes sealed the Black Mage. Hundreds of years passed, but the king still serves the Black Mage as a loyal vassal. I've given up. I'm tired of waiting. There's only one thing left to do...
